label: Median transacted price change, 2023 vs 2022
source: Dubai Land Department transactions export (Kaggle mirror zainabhejairi/dubai-real-estates-1969-2023, DLD_Transactions.csv)
provenance: UNOFFICIAL third-party mirror of a DLD export. Schema matches DLD field names (trans_group_en, procedure_name_en, reg_type_en, rooms_en, actual_worth). The file is exactly 1,048,575 rows, which is Excel's 1,048,576-row ceiling, so it is a TRUNCATED copy of the registry rather than the complete one. 132 rows carry Hijri-calendar years (<1990) and are discarded.
method: Percentage change in the median residential sale price (actual_worth) between 2022 and 2023, per community. Requires at least 25 priced residential sales in EACH year.
limitation: Based on TRANSACTED prices from the DLD registry, not on listing/asking prices, so it is not directly comparable to a listing-price index. Annual, not most-recent-month. Median price is sensitive to the mix of unit sizes and types sold in each year, so it is not a like-for-like appreciation measure. The export ends in 2023.
